subject: Quick product preview — pick a 30-minute slot & attendees
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@nimblecare.com>, Priya Shah <priya@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Quick product preview — pick a 30-minute slot & attendees

Hi Alex + Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to hear more about NimbleCare's intake pipeline and the pain points you're seeing around triage latency and context across patient notes. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal for next meeting: 30-minute product preview focused on how Redwood can reduce inference cost while keeping latency under your 150ms target and how to integrate with your ingest pipeline.
- Proposed agenda (short): 1) 5m quick recap, 2) 10m live preview of inference flow and batching, 3) 10m Q&A / integration questions, 4) 5m next steps.

Please pick one of these times (all PT):
1) Tue Sep 2, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed Sep 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu Sep 4, 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Also: who from your team should join for the integration/infra questions? If you expect a technical owner (CTO/Head of Eng), we can switch to a 45-minute deep dive instead.

I've attached a one‑page agenda and will hold times until I hear back. If none of these work, propose two windows that do and we'll make it happen.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_preview_agenda.pdf (1 page PDF)]

Marissa,

Thanks — helpful recap. We can do Wed Sep 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT. Priya will join from product. I'll also bring in our CTO, Samir Kulkarni (cc'd inline below) if possible — Samir wants to see how the KV cache and batching would slot into our ingestion pipeline. If a 45-minute slot makes more sense with Samir, we can extend.

Two quick asks before we lock: 1) can you share a short list of integration notes (preferred input format, auth options) and 2) an estimate of typical token cost at 150ms SLO for a production-like workload (~500 concurrent requests)?

Appreciate it — Samir's email: samir@nimblecare.com

—Alex
Director of Product, NimbleCare
